app_fee.value: USD 90, non-refundable, paid online by credit card.
app_fee.quote: The nonrefundable $90 application fee is payable online via credit card.

fee_waiver.value: Only set categories qualify: McNair Scholars, applicants with a GRE fee reduction, and eligible domestic students from underrepresented groups in listed programs. There is no general hardship waiver for international applicants.
fee_waiver.quote: Applicants in the following categories may qualify for a Graduate School application fee waiver: | Members of the McNair Scholars Program | Applicants who qualify for a GRE fee reduction | Eligible domestic students from underrepresented groups who are participants of organizations and programs listed on the Recruitment page.

gre_general.value: The Graduate School does not set a GRE rule for PhD programs; each academic program decides (see the program records).
gre_general.quote: waiving the GRE or GMAT requirement is at the discretion of the academic program to which you are applying

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT: a minimum combined score of 4 on the new scale for tests taken from January 2026; 80 for tests taken before January 2026. Many programs expect higher scores.
toefl_min.quote: Test of English as a Foreign Language (TOEFL): For tests taken January 2026 or later, a minimum combined score of 4 (new scale as of January 2026). For tests taken prior to January 2026, a minimum combined score of 80. | Minimum scores required for admission are set by our Graduate Council; however, many graduate programs expect higher scores for admission.

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic minimum combined score of 6.5 (Duolingo 115 and PTE Academic 53 are also accepted).
ielts_min.quote: International English Language Testing System (IELTS Academic): Minimum combined score of 6.5

english_waiver.value: The test is waived only for citizens of listed countries, degrees from the US or those countries, or a few listed institutions. India is not listed, so Indian applicants need a test score.
english_waiver.quote: Your standardized English language proficiency test requirement may be waived if one of these conditions exists: | You have citizenship of Australia, Botswana, Canada, Caribbean English speaking countries, Dominica, Gambia, Ghana, Great Britain, Guyana, Hong Kong, Ireland, Kenya, Lesotho, Liberia, Malawi, Namibia, New Zealand, Nigeria, Scotland, Sierra Leone, South Africa, Swaziland, Tanzania, Uganda, West Indies, Zambia, Zimbabwe. | You have earned a bachelor’s or master’s degree in the United States or in one of the countries listed above.

notes: Three-year Indian bachelor's degrees are not treated as equivalent to a US four-year degree (see the international applicants page). Also offers PhDs in Polymer Science and Engineering, Microbiology, Organismic and Evolutionary Biology, Plant Biology, Animal Sciences, Industrial Engineering and Operations Research and public-health fields that are not saved as separate programs here.
